connect.heading: Connect your AI in 3 steps
connect.lead: Diluxite is the memory of your AI. This lets Claude / Copilot read, write and search your memory by meaning — remembering across sessions.
connect.step2Hint: Copy it now (it will not be shown again):
connect.step3: Paste the URL and token in Claude / Copilot as a remote connector. Done.
connect.tip: Tip: in Claude Code, add to your CLAUDE.md: “Before answering, search with search_memory; when something is worth keeping, save it with write_note.”

search.heading: Search
search.lead: How your AI searches the memory. Hybrid combines keyword + meaning (recommended). Keyword-only is literal. Semantic-only ignores the exact word.

ai.heading: AI / Embeddings
ai.lead: The engine that turns your notes into searchable meaning. local works without keys (reasonable quality, ideal to get started). azure (Azure OpenAI) gives better quality and switches on via environment variables:
